view_frame: Front view (XZ) displays the wheel face with X as horizontal width and Z as vertical height. Right view (YZ) displays the side profile with Y as depth (thickness) and Z as height. The wheel is a flat disc lying in the XZ plane with thickness along Y.

features.section: Closed XY profile (interpreted as XZ face) extruded along Y
features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Outer boundary is a circle of radius 60 mm in XZ. Inner boundary is a circle of radius 15 mm in XZ. The profile consists of the annulus between these circles, minus 8 rectangular cutouts (spokes) of width 10 mm, rotated at 45-degree intervals.
features.evidence: Front view shows concentric circles and 8 spokes. Text annotation states 'OD 120 mm; thickness 8 mm; 8 spokes'.

connections: The 8 spokes connect the central hub to the outer rim.
The rim connects the outer ends of all spokes.
The hub connects the inner ends of all spokes.
edit_rules: Changing OD 120 mm updates the outer circle radius.
Changing thickness 8 mm updates the extrusion depth along Y.
Changing ASSUMED rim_width updates the inner radius of the outer circle.
Changing ASSUMED hub_diameter updates the radius of the inner circle.
Changing ASSUMED spoke_width updates the width of the 8 rectangular cutouts.
unresolved: Rim width is not dimensioned; assumed 10 mm.
Hub diameter is not dimensioned; assumed 30 mm.
Spoke width is not dimensioned; assumed 10 mm.
